sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Penalty Power 2021 is a penalty kick game that challenges players to shoot and defend shots using a combination of mouse controls. The game features a variety of characters from Cartoon Network shows, each with their unique abilities and strengths. The gameplay is divided into two main components: shooting and defending. When shooting, players use the mouse to swipe in the direction they want to shoot, with the goal of scoring as many goals as possible within the time limit. Defending is equally challenging, as players use the mouse to tap where they think the ball is heading to intercept it. With each match, the difficulty level increases, providing a thrilling experience for players who are able to adapt to the changing pace and speed of the game.

The game also features a range of power-ups and special abilities that players can use to gain an edge over their opponents. Throughout the game, players are also treated to a range of animations and sound effects that add to the overall atmosphere and immersion. The game's visuals are bright and colorful, with each character and environment rendered in high detail. The sound effects, from the whoosh of the ball flying through the air to the satisfying 'thud' of hitting the back of the net, add to the overall excitement and energy of the game, making for a truly immersive experience.
